cases.answer: Use the provisional Qwen3 4B Q4_K_M model through loopback-only llama.cpp for private work. Route only public, difficult tasks to the bounded Groq model. Keep deterministic commands local, cap attempts and tokens, and require the frozen accuracy, privacy and latency checks before promoting either route. Responsiveness and battery impact remain measured gates, not promises.
expected: Uses a small quantized local model for private work, bounded cloud for public hard tasks, and explicit quality gates.
